# whose-code-site

> Public case study for whose-code: 20,245 commits of our own agent-built code audited by our authorship scanner. Zero commits classed without a direct confession.

whose-code-site is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).

- [Landing page](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/whose-code-site/): overview, features, FAQ
